description.text: The first Beginning Set of the Black & White series, released on 29 October 2010 together with Beginning Set for Girl. Made for players about to start battling, it held three ready-built 30-card half decks led by Serperior, Emboar and Samurott, the final evolutions of the Unova starters, using only Pokémon new in Pokémon Black and White, with a playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers, three quick guides, a rule book and a how-to-play DVD. The for Girl version has a few Pokémon cards found only in it, and its items have their own designs. Early copies carried a serial code for the Pokémon Global Link website, good for a Turtwig, Chimchar or Piplup with a Hidden Ability in the Pokémon Dream World. DX editions of both, adding a deck case, sleeves, a mini notebook, stickers and a trunk case, followed on 20 November 2010. Beginning Set+ and Beginning Set DX Pikachu ver. brought its cards back in 2011, each under its own code.
